verdict.rationale: Activepieces' durable-execution docs state that interrupted runs 'resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over,' which supports resuming a failed run from the failing step, and audit logs exist for agent/tool actions. However, there is no direct documentation of an ops-facing execution log viewer for flow runs or an explicit 're-run failed flow' UI feature. missing for 10: dedicated flow execution history/log UI, explicit re-run-from-failed-step control for regular flows (not just agent audit logs), independent confirmation of this workflow.
